instruction: A candid full-shot photograph in a bright indoor ballet studio with a light curtain. The woman in the black leotard (R1) stands behind the young girl in the pink tutu (R2). Both hold their arms high overhead in an elegant ballet position, with the instructor (R1) aligning her posture with the student's. The young girl (R2) looks upward at her curved arms in profile, while the instructor (R1) maintains a focused profile. Soft, natural light illuminates the clean, neutral-toned setting with a shallow depth of field.
